root_cause.text: In `ets_qdisc_change()`, when a DRR class transitions to strict mode, the class is not removed from the DRR active list, leaving a stale entry that later causes a double list addition when the class is changed back to DRR.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states: "the ets code isn't checking whether that class was in the active list and removing it. This means that, if a user changes a strict class (which was in the active list) back to a drr one, that class will be added twice to the active list." The patch adds a loop (`for (i = q->nstrict; i < nstrict; i++)`) that calls `list_del_init(&q->classes[i].alist)` to remove classes transitioning from DRR to strict from the active list. The kernel splat shows a `list_add double add` warning triggered at `ets_qdisc_change`.
